about: The world canary (the lead, 24 November: what CI found red over nine batches, most of it a change that moved every world, found 20 minutes after a push): the world-level walks that catch a province, kit, generator, rule or name moving every world, run by scripts/test-changed.ts whatever their speed when a change can move every world, and alone by `bun run test:canary`. Chosen from the specs CI found red on 24 November, the heaviest few (whole adventures' long plays) left to CI. Held to about two minutes on six workers (the owner, 24 November: seven had been too long for a local lane): its kept CPU at most budget.cpuSeconds, no file over budget.fileSeconds (test/small/push-lane). Kept by what caught a change moving every world; the heaviest walks and the old sentinels are the night's. Its cheaper replacements, when they land, take places here: names apart by identity (OR-418) for story-names, no lead goes round (OR-417) for honest-start. Run on ten workers (the machine has sixteen cores); glance-kite left out, its timing check failing under local load.
